title: An extension of the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines
$comment: What an extension of the guidelines adds to the structure of the specification, kept in _schema/extensions/<name>.schema.json, and what a project's own guidelines add, kept in specs/_schema/project.schema.json (s-eferktypcj7njt5, s-xm8rz4uupb73gu5). The tools compose the schema of the guidelines with the schema of each extension the project has chosen, then with the project's: each kind joins the kinds a node may have and its schema holds where a node is of that kind, each type of link joins the types a link may have, each definition joins those the composed schema holds, and the properties of a file and of a link join theirs. Each addition is a condition beside those already composed, so nothing loosens a condition, and a name already composed is refused, so nothing redefines one. A reference in an added schema to #/$defs/<name> names a definition of the composed node schema.

kinds.$comment: The kinds of node it adds, each by its name: whether its nodes need code, and the JSON Schema of the fields its nodes hold beside those every node holds (s-hhnahzmhahf8jht). A kind the SpecSheriff guidelines define cannot be declared, nor a name an earlier release gave one of them, which the reindex renames: record, recordType, rule and domain. A kind an extension already composed adds is refused at the composition.

needsCode.$comment: false where the nodes of the kind are carried out by tools or people rather than code, which exempts them from being implemented.

linkTypes.$comment: The types of link it adds (s-sn6au3vcr9uy5pm), each by its name; the rule that defines a type states its meaning. A type already composed is refused at the composition.

fields.$comment: The fields added to a kind that is already composed, as a JSON Schema of their properties, by the kind's name. A kind not composed is refused at the composition. The nodes of the SpecSheriff guidelines and of its extensions need not hold them.

file.$comment: The properties added to a file of the specification and of its archive, as a JSON Schema of them.

link.$comment: The properties added to a link, as a JSON Schema of them.

$defs.$comment: Definitions its schemas refer to as #/$defs/<name>, joining those of the composed node schema. A name already composed is refused at the composition.
